description: This file is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically handling the Wizard interface for campaign creation and management within the Campaigns module. It contains logic for displaying campaign details, managing relationships, and navigating through the campaign wizard steps, including marketing and target list summaries.

methods.name: create_campaign_summary
methods.description: Generates an HTML table summarizing campaign details, including name, status, dates, and related action buttons.

methods.name: create_marketing_summary
methods.description: Creates an HTML table listing associated marketing emails with options to create new, test, or send emails.

methods.name: create_target_summary
methods.description: Produces an HTML table displaying prospect lists or subscriptions related to the campaign, with links to view or edit.

methods.name: create_tracker_summary
methods.description: Builds an HTML table of URL trackers associated with the campaign, showing their names and URLs.

methods.name: create_wiz_menu_items
methods.description: Generates a navigation menu with steps for the campaign wizard, including specific steps for newsletter or email campaigns.
